answer_1.quote: Music generation is a popular application of deep learning models . We ought to experiment on this task to demonstrate the benefits of BPE on music modeling.
answer_1.outputs: symbolic music sequences in tokenized format

answer_2.quote: we introduce a new metric we called Tokenization Syntax Errors (TSE).

answer_4.quote: We gathered nine participants, among which seven are musicians, to evaluate the results.
answer_4.guideline: They were asked to open the MIDI files with Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) softwares such as Logic Pro or Ableton, play each track individually and select the best one on four criteria: 1) fidelity on pitch scale and rhythm regarding the prompt; 2) correctness, i.e. featuring good note succession and harmony; 3) coherent diversity, i.e. featuring diverse correct melodies and harmonies; 4) their overall subjective preference.
